title: The Importance of Being ‘Dialed In’
credits: Anna Matteo wrote this story for VOA Learning English.

sentences.en: And now, Words and Their Stories, from VOA Learning English.
sentences.zh: 现在，让我们来听听“词汇与他们的故事”，来自美国之音英语学习。

sentences.en: Technology is always progressing.
sentences.zh: 技术总是在不断进步。

sentences.en: Today, many modern devices can be controlled by touch or voice.
sentences.zh: 如今，许多现代设备都可以通过触摸或语音来控制。

sentences.en: This has led to some traditional electronic controls – such as dials and switches – being replaced with new technologies.
sentences.zh: 这导致一些传统的电子控制装置——比如旋钮和开关——被新技术所取代。

sentences.en: Digital displays have also become increasingly common.
sentences.zh: 数字显示屏也变得日益普遍。

sentences.en: For example, digital number readouts have long replaced the hands on many clocks.
sentences.zh: 例如，数字数字读数早就取代了许多钟表上的指针。

sentences.en: Many other devices also now operate purely with digital tools instead of mechanical systems.
sentences.zh: 许多其他设备现在也完全使用数字工具运作，而不是机械系统。

sentences.en: But some expressions and idioms used by English speakers still describe older technologies.
sentences.zh: 但是一些英语使用者使用的表达方式和习语仍然描述着较老的技术。

sentences.en: First, let’s talk about dials.
sentences.zh: 首先，让我们来谈谈旋钮。

sentences.en: These controls are used for changing settings on a piece of equipment, like a radio or old television.
sentences.zh: 这些控制装置用于改变设备的设置，比如收音机或老式电视机。

sentences.en: We use the dial to tune in to a specific channel.
sentences.zh: 我们用旋钮来调谐到特定的频道。

sentences.en: That’s where the expressions dialed in and tuned in come from.
sentences.zh: 这就是“dialed in”和“tuned in”这两个表达方式的由来。

sentences.en: If we are dialed in or tuned in to a radio or television program, we can hear it clearly.
sentences.zh: 如果我们“dialed in”或“tuned in”到某个收音机或电视节目，我们就能清楚地听到它。

sentences.en: There is no noise or static.
sentences.zh: 没有噪音或静电干扰。

sentences.en: The same can be said when using these terms in personal conversations.
sentences.zh: 在个人对话中使用这些词时，情况也是如此。

sentences.en: For example, if you are dialed in to a project or problem, you know exactly what needs to be done.
sentences.zh: 例如，如果你“dialed in”到一个项目或问题上，你就确切地知道需要做什么。

sentences.en: You are thinking clearly about it and remain very focused.
sentences.zh: 你正在清晰地思考它，并保持非常专注。

sentences.en: And when you are tuned in, you understand clearly what is going on around you.
sentences.zh: 当你“tuned in”时，你就能清楚地理解周围发生的事情。

sentences.en: “Don’t touch that dial” and “stay tuned” are two ways to tell someone to keep watching or listening to a program.
sentences.zh: “Don't touch that dial”和“stay tuned”是告诉别人继续观看或收听节目的两种方式。

sentences.en: Now, let’s talk about switches.
sentences.zh: 现在，让我们来谈谈开关。

sentences.en: These are built to either be off or on.
sentences.zh: 这些开关要么处于关闭状态，要么处于开启状态。

sentences.en: There are no in-between settings like with a dial.
sentences.zh: 它们没有像旋钮那样的中间档位设置。

sentences.en: So, when we flip the switch, we make something happen quickly and easily.
sentences.zh: 所以，当我们拨动开关时，就能迅速而轻松地促成某事的发生。

sentences.en: It can also mean that we suddenly change something.
sentences.zh: 它也可以表示我们突然改变某事。

sentences.en: Let’s listen to an example.
sentences.zh: 让我们来听一个例子。

sentences.en: The restaurant’s change to all organic food happened slowly over time.
sentences.zh: 这家餐厅全面改用有机食品的转变是随着时间的推移慢慢发生的。

sentences.en: It wasn’t a matter of flipping a switch.
sentences.zh: 这并非一按开关就能解决的问题。

sentences.en: Now, for our last expression -- to move the needle.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们来学习最后一个短语——推动进展（to move the needle）。

sentences.en: Needles on measuring devices like a scale move to show a desired level has been reached.
sentences.zh: 在秤等测量仪器上，指针会移动以显示已达到预期的水平。

sentences.en: So, when something moves the needle, it causes a noticeable change in something, usually for the good.
sentences.zh: 因此，当某事“推动进展”时，它会引起某事物明显的变化，通常是向好的方面转变。

sentences.en: And that’s all the time we have for this Words and Their Stories.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期“词汇及其故事”的全部内容。

sentences.en: Don't forget to tune in again for another story about American English expressions.
sentences.zh: 别忘了再次收听，我们将带来另一则关于美式英语习语的故事。

sentences.en: Until next time, I’m Anna Matteo.
sentences.zh: 下次见，我是安娜·马泰奥。

talking or a talk between two or more people
